Turquoise| Platform Operations Engineers| Remote, USA

Turquoise a series C healthtech company is recruiting for two platform engineers to join the newly created platform operations team. You can expect to work closely with our Data Engineering team based in Europe, drive observability, define the metrics for reliability and help to share our platform infrastructure.

Click on one of the following links best aligned with your exp to apply:
